Reason for Mistake: Misclassification of Field/Domain Information and Premature Task Completion. The agent correctly identified Henry Cavendish as the physicist who first measured the gravitational constant but failed to align the final answer with the modern, precise classification requested by the user ("physics"). Instead, it provided an indirect or historically contextualized answer ("Chemistry (experimental chemistry)") based on the fact that Cavendish was also a chemist. This dilutes the specificity of the response and ignores the primary context of the achievement (measuring G, a fundamental constant of physics). The agent prematurely declared the task complete without validating that the answer directly addressed the "field of work" in the context of the specific scientific achievement mentioned.
